decisions_override_reason_consistent.name: decisions_override_reason_consistent
decisions_override_reason_consistent.value: ("decisions"."final_decision" = "decisions"."automated_decision" AND "decisions"."override_reason" IS NULL) OR ("decisions"."final_decision" <> "decisions"."automated_decision" AND "decisions"."override_reason" IS NOT NULL)

observations_baseline_scope.name: observations_baseline_scope
observations_baseline_scope.value: ("observations"."kind" = 'baseline' AND "observations"."experiment_id" IS NULL) OR ("observations"."kind" <> 'baseline' AND "observations"."experiment_id" IS NOT NULL)

observations_measurement_identity.name: observations_measurement_identity
observations_measurement_identity.value: ("observations"."kind" <> 'guardrail' AND "observations"."metric_definition_id" IS NOT NULL AND "observations"."constraint_definition_id" IS NULL) OR ("observations"."kind" = 'guardrail' AND "observations"."metric_definition_id" IS NULL AND "observations"."constraint_definition_id" IS NOT NULL)

idempotency_keys_response_complete.name: idempotency_keys_response_complete
idempotency_keys_response_complete.value: ("idempotency_keys"."response_status" IS NULL AND "idempotency_keys"."response_body" IS NULL AND "idempotency_keys"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("idempotency_keys"."response_status" BETWEEN 100 AND 599 AND "idempotency_keys"."response_body" IS NOT NULL AND "idempotency_keys"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

experiments_completed_after_started.name: experiments_completed_after_started
experiments_completed_after_started.value: "experiments"."completed_at" IS NULL OR "experiments"."started_at" IS NULL OR "experiments"."completed_at" >= "experiments"."started_at"

runs_completed_after_started.name: runs_completed_after_started
runs_completed_after_started.value: "runs"."completed_at" IS NULL OR "runs"."started_at" IS NULL OR "runs"."completed_at" >= "runs"."started_at"
